blocks.orig: The Golden Tulip Hotel in the Masaki area of Dar Es Salaam lies on the oceanfront of Tanzania’s largest city, where the 4-star hotel chain offers lovely ensuite rooms in a mix of Maritime and Arabic Swahili design. Small balconies offer breathtaking views from the spacious air-conditioned rooms, equipped with all necessary amenities. Guests in need of some sustenance can choose from a pizza restaurant, a coffee bar, or the Sanaa Restaurant, where chefs love to turn their dishes into a form of art (sanaa meaning art in Swahili). To top it off, a large infinity pool and poolside bar boast sea views and the best options for a well-deserved cooling down.
blocks.html: The Golden Tulip Hotel stands in the Masaki area of Dar Es Salaam, on the seafront of Tanzania’s biggest city, where this 4-star hotel chain has pleasant ensuite rooms designed in a blend of Maritime and Arabic Swahili styles. The spacious, air-conditioned rooms come with all the necessary amenities, and their small balconies give stunning views. If you are hungry, you can pick a pizza restaurant, a coffee bar or the Sanaa Restaurant, where the chefs like to make each dish a work of art (sanaa means art in Swahili). On top of that, there is a large infinity pool with a poolside bar, both with sea views and perfect for a well-earned cool-down.
